72. Cyclic Right Shift Array

Problem Statement:
Given two numbers N,K followed by an array of N elements, print the array after doing right shift K times (in cyclic manner).
input_spec: The input consists of two numbers N, K, followed by an array of N elements. Input Size: 1 <= N, K <= 100000.
output_spec: The output is the array after performing a right cyclic shift K times.
